scope: Independent source/negative-boundary/receipt review; no tests/provider/GPU repeated
source_checks: Reuse is private same-job memory state, consumed only by the next normal numbered round; lineage records original round/artifactSHA and explicitly marks no new diagnosis request.

Retained source must exactly be the selected original Lab source copy, with complete manifest/catalog equality, all actual file hashes/sizes and evidence bytes; source/policy/goal/argv/reference/seed/allocator/selected state changes disable reuse.
Current validate_diagnosis is called again with current evidence/policy/required saving; only ready and no-supplement responses may reach reuse, never host-cleared needs_more_info.
Fresh Super patch is built from reverted retained source, with complete failed diff and bounded untrusted runtime source frames; failed candidate does not become retained source.

Only actual clean completed-capture Python implementation errors qualify. OOM/timeout/CUDA runtime errors, preflight/static failure, no target execution, partial/unclean capture and known numerical/precision/parameter/policy changes do not qualify.
A completed candidate failing only numerical reference cannot qualify as a Python implementation failure; unavailable reference evidence is never promoted to acceptance.
Per-ticket8192 and shared solver64KiB limits retain normal admission. Oversize/unavailable context or invalidated fingerprint/validator falls back to ordinary Ultra diagnosis.

Every candidate still uses existing PatchEngine sandbox, static policy, reference preflight, real verification, keep/revert and billing hooks. Refinements consume existing six rounds, with no seventh round or third diagnostic supplement.

ServerStore keeps its closed event-kind contract with exactly two registered additions. Web parseEvent accepts string kinds rather than rejecting the stream; root added both listener kinds and product labels without exposing new raw fields.
Optional malformed fingerprint/manifest failure now returnsNone rather than aborting ordinary diagnosis.

legacy_bounded_prerequisite_review_attri.scope: Existing neutral review behavior; old test request-count expectation synchronized, not acceptance loosened

nonblocking_limits: Strategy reuse is schema/reference/policy revalidation, not proof of mathematical correctness or a new model response.
Version1 intentionally disables reuse for kept patch trees outside selected original Lab copy.
Implementation error labels and trace data remain cooperative/untrusted; fresh verification gates remain necessary.
